root.title: Hexapod
root.description: A six-legged source assembly with eighteen revolute joints.

source.author: ggldnl / Hexapod contributors; display adaptation by Annora
source.attribution: Hexapod · ggldnl and contributors · CERN-OHL-W-2.0. Display adaptation and illustrative motion: Annora, 2026.
source.description: A six-legged source assembly with eighteen revolute joints.
source.note: Source hardware and joint frames are retained. Derived geometry, finishes and separation are illustrative. The single-leg clip is an authored pose study, not firmware output, gait or balance simulation.

stages.title: Start from the stance
stages.description: The source leg rests in its authored standing pose.

stages.title: Lift through the femur
stages.description: One leg lifts while the other five remain in their source display stance.

stages.title: Reach through the tibia
stages.description: A small tibia rotation extends the selected leg.

stages.title: Return to the same pose
stages.description: Every articulated transform returns exactly to the original display stance.
